title: desmotrichum criniferum
intro: Desmotrichum criniferum, commonly known as the "Fairy's Comb," is a type of flowering plant in the family Thymelaeaceae. It is a shrub native to India and Sri Lanka, used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating skin conditions and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Desmotrichum criniferum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
